title: Branded IDs and validation
description: Secure branded ids and validation boundaries through runtime validation, typed results and local TypeScript tests rather than trusting erased annotations.
objectives: Distinguish static typing from runtime trust in branded ids and validation
Validate unknown input or normalize transport data before constructing a domain value
Verify rejected and accepted cases with runnable tests plus compiler checks
rubric: I can identify the untrusted runtime boundary in branded ids and validation.
I reject at least one malformed input and validate one successful case.
I avoid unchecked type assertions in public API contracts.
